system.description:
The mounted elite of the Eltor court — lance and horse, elegance and violence.

  • Lancer's Charge: A charge triples the lance's damage dice (not doubles them) while mounted. Flat modifiers are not multiplied.
  • Eltor Horsemastery: Advantage on Horsemanship checks to perform advanced manoeuvres, and on checks evaluating horse quality.
